## Hypothesis

Running walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) on 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) will confirm whether the current engine baseline maintains edge capture above the OP-16 floor and exhibits stable performance across regimes.

## Mechanism

We will run the existing engine logic (as defined in heartbeat.md and params.json) over the OOS window using cached 5m SPY bars and real OPRA fills for options, computing per-trade P&L and aggregating edge capture on J anchor days. Real-fills validation will replay the top 3 J days with realistic bid/ask, slippage, and fill models to compare against BS-simulated results.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20).
2. **Sample bias:** The OOS window is 12 months (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) selected chronologically after the in-sample window used for leaderboard candidates (which varies). Overfit risk is mitigated by walk-forward design but remains if regime shifts.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet executed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J day validation not yet executed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large gap move against position; max drawdown could exceed 30% of equity if edge deteriorates; blow-up scenario involves consecutive losses exceeding daily loss limit.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X; currently unknown requires backtest.
